page.intro_en: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) conducted an interview on 04 November 2026 for the direct recruitment of 1 unreserved post of Professor Cardiology under the Medical Education Department (Allopathy), advertised via Advertisement Number D-1/E-1/2026, Department Number S-8/09. According to the official notice, no candidate appeared for the interview. Consequently, the commission has recommended forwarding and re-advertising the post as per rules.
